guardrail.name: crisis_detection
guardrail.prompt:
=Analyze this message for crisis indicators:
- Active suicidal ideation (plans, means, timeline)
- Self-harm intent (cutting, overdose, etc.)
- Intent to harm others
- Psychotic break indicators

Return JSON:
{
  "crisis_detected": boolean,
  "severity": "none" | "moderate" | "severe",
  "type": "self_harm" | "harm_to_others" | "suicidal" | "psychotic" | null,
  "reasoning": "brief explanation"
}

assignments.name: output
assignments.value:
=I hear you, and I want you to know that what you're sharing matters. This is beyond what I'm able to support you with right now, but you don't have to navigate this alone.
Please reach out to your coach directly - they want to hear from you, especially in moments like this. I've also notified them that you may need support.
If you need to talk to someone right now:

988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline - call or text)
Crisis Text Line - text HOME to 741741

I'm still here if you want to talk, but please do reach out to your coach or one of these lines. You deserve real human support right now.

parameters.query:
select u.fullname,first_name,last_name,email
from sds_users u join sds_user_supports s on u.id=s.sds_user_id
where s.user_id={{ $('Consolidate Data').item.json.body.userId || 0 }}
order by s.insert_date desc
limit 1

select da.user_id, da.id as assessment_id, da.i_am  ,
max(case when e2.is_negative =true then name end) as "negative",
max(case when (e2.is_negative =false or e2.is_negative is null)  then name end) as "positive",
score,
score_avg,
score_stddev,
sc.title as addiction
  
from daily_assessments da
inner join public.users us on us.id = da.user_id
join public.daily_assessment_emotions e on da.id=e.daily_assessment_id
join emotions e2 on e.emotion_id =e2.id
left join vdbm_user_daily_stats ds on  da.user_id = ds.user_id
join addictions sc on us.addiction_id =sc.id
where da.user_id={{  $('Consolidate Data').item.json.body.userId|| 0 }}
group by da.id, score_avg,score_stddev,us.first_name,da.user_id,sc.title

limit 5
